summary: Union Co., OR: 40-ft pole tower (1938) replaced in 1954 by an 82-ft timber tower; removed or destroyed in 1975; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40-foot pole L-4 tower built 1938; replaced 1954 by an 82-foot treated timber tower with L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Removed in 1975 per the Former Fire Lookout Sites register; the Fire Lookout page says destroyed that year

staffing.status: Named lookout staff in 1931, 1950, 1954 and 1958; no end of staffing found

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Wallowa-Whitman National Forest

events.note: John Brigham returned to his duties at Flat Lake (La Grande Observer, July 25, 1931)
40-foot pole L-4 tower constructed; the first lookout was a crow's nest tree platform set up in the late 1920s
Lookout spotted two small blazes in the Starkey vicinity (September 12, 1949); Forest Service crews extinguished them
Mr. and Mrs. Robert Albritton stationed at the lookout for the summer (July 27, 1950 item)
Lookout spotted a small lightning fire on Tower Ridge, about 25 miles west of La Grande; discovered and suppressed (September 5, 1953)
82-foot treated timber tower with L-4 cab replaced the 40-foot pole tower
Tower removed per the Former Fire Lookout Sites register; the Fire Lookout page says destroyed
Registered January 4, 2011; nominated by Irene Potter

evidence.supports: first lookout was a crow's nest tree platform, late 1920s
evidence.quote: The first lookout on this site was a crow's nest tree platform set up in the late 1920's.

evidence.supports: replaced in 1954 by 82-foot treated timber tower; removed in 1975
evidence.quote: This was replaced by an 82' treated timber tower with L-4 cab in 1954. It was removed in 1975.

evidence.supports: 17 miles west of La Grande, Union County

evidence.quote: Known lookout personnel: 1954: John Gray; 1958: George Moore.

evidence.supports: John Brigham returned to his duties at Flat Lake, July 1931 (La Grande Observer)
evidence.quote: July 25, 1931: John Brigham returned to his duties at Flat Lake recently.

evidence.quote: July 27, 1950: Mr. and Mrs. Kenneth Price spent the weekend visiting Mr. and Mrs. Robert Albritton, who are stationed at Flat Lake Lookout station for the summer.

evidence.quote: September 5, 1953: La Grande office of the Whitman National Forest reports a small lightning fire which was discovered and suppressed Thursday. The fire was spotted from Flat Lake lookout on Tower Ridge, about 25 miles West of La Grande.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites register says the tower was removed in 1975; the Fire Lookout page says it was destroyed that year. Both agree on 1975. The story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: Brief had no height; 25.0 m is the 82-ft tower per the FFLOS register. The late-1920s tree platform has no exact year, so it is not an event. The register says removed and the Fire Lookout page says destroyed (both 1975). The only site-level detail is a 1936 Forest Service survey station description; whether the mark or any footing survives is unverified. No photos added; the FFLOS 2001 marker photo has no confirmed licence.
